description: Live USD price for up to 20 mints (GET /prices/:mint per mint). A MISSING PRICE IS DATA, not a failure: a mint that cannot be priced has no usable route or liquidity, which is itself the answer to "can this be a basket leg" — no. Mints that could not be priced come back in `unpriced`; report that, never substitute a zero.
